decision.rationale: The change adds generic evidence-bound L6 calibration and app-domain approved-baseline contracts. App-owned identity, semantic thresholds, rubric, provider, dataset, and Exit policy remain outside agentic_core. The completed run stays immutable, L6 cannot write L4, and UWG remains the only durable baseline path.

spine_substrate_test.evidence: Generic L6 Spearman profiles, samples, results, reliability signals, and post-boundary adapters are declarative and app-neutral.

any_app_capability_test.evidence: The core engine accepts caller-supplied identity, dataset, thresholds, rubric, and provider metadata without branching on an app identifier.

app_owned_meaning_test.evidence: All resume-specific calibration meaning and approved-use interpretation are supplied by apps_rg configuration and runtime bindings.

no_app_literal_test.evidence: GOV-3 pre-signature scan reported 0 forbidden-literal findings across changed core paths.

plugin_test.evidence: Focused L6, runtime-judge, exhaust-adapter, app binding, and CI tests passed: 445 passed.

negative_control_test.evidence: Core author-gate schema/negative controls passed 43 tests; dataset, calibration, and promotion gates each exited 1 in explicit fail-closed mode.

platform_approval_test.evidence: The user explicitly supplied and requested execution of plan apps-rg-spearman-l6-calibration-spine-c8f4a2, including its core and governance changes.

boundary_preservation_test.evidence: Identity and L6-placement gates passed; tests prove post-Exit execution, no current-run rescue, no direct L4 write, and UWG-only registration.

contract_compatibility_test.evidence: Focused compatibility suite passed 445 tests and the targeted app-domain UWG suite passed 8 tests with 1 unrelated discovery-wide fixture test deselected.

runtime_proof_compatibility_test.evidence: End-to-end tests prove Exit to sealed exhaust to L6.4 to RCA/promotion to UWG to L4 to next-run Exit, without mutating the completed run.
